Name: Florida Triple Exposure Cascade
Pathway: Tourism Decline → Hospitality stress → Workforce Displacement → Labor shortages → Insurance/Climate Push → Housing demand decline → Tax Revenue Decline → Accelerated Out-Migration
Mechanism: Tourism hits hospitality. Workforce displacement removes workers for remaining jobs AND construction. Insurance pushes residents out. Prices drop. Tax base erodes. Services decline. More leave. Each stress makes others worse.
Feedback Loops: Out-migration → lower demand → price drops → more out-migration; Labor shortage → service decline → tourist dissatisfaction → fewer visitors
Breakpoint: Florida net domestic migration turns negative (VX-MARCO-3.03 → BREACHED)
Lag Time: 18-36 months from initial stress to population reversal

Name: Canadian Tourism → Regional Economy
Pathway: Canadian visitor decline → Direct spending loss → Hotel occupancy drops → Retail spending drops (border) → Business closures → Tax revenue decline → Service cuts
Mechanism: Canadians are #1 visitors. Many regional economies have significant Canadian exposure. 26% decline creates immediate revenue loss cascading through local economy.
Feedback Loops: Business closures → job losses → reduced local spending → more closures
Breakpoint: Business closures in tourism-dependent areas accelerate
Lag Time: 3-6 months from visitor decline to business impact

Name: Workforce Displacement → Sector Disruption
Pathway: Enforcement → Worker departure → Labor shortage (ag, construction, hospitality) → Output reduction OR wage spike → Price increases → Inflation pressure + reduced activity
Mechanism: 42% farmworkers, 25% construction undocumented. Cannot be quickly replaced domestically. Skills mismatch, wage expectations, geography don't align. Short-term: production cuts or wage/price increases.
Feedback Loops: Labor shortage → wage pressure → cost pass-through → demand reduction → business viability stress
Breakpoint: Food supply disruptions visible; construction delays widespread
Lag Time: Immediate labor impact; 3-6 months to price/supply effects

Name: Climate/Insurance → Migration Reversal
Pathway: Climate risk increases → Insurance costs rise → Housing affordability declines → Out-migration pressure → Home prices stagnate/decline → Wealth effect → Population outflow → Tax base erosion
Mechanism: SF Fed: "Snow Belt to Sun Belt migration likely reversed." Mechanism is economic — insurance/housing costs make Sunbelt increasingly expensive vs alternatives. First Street: 55M relocations by 2055.
Feedback Loops: Out-migration → lower prices → wealth loss → reduced spending → economic stress → more out-migration
Breakpoint: Florida net domestic migration turns negative
Lag Time: 5-15 years for full reversal; 2-3 years for measurable migration shift

Name: Municipal Fiscal Crisis → Regional Transmission
Pathway: Municipal deficit → Pension underfunding → Service cuts → Property devaluation → Bank CRE exposure → Regional bank stress → Credit tightening → Economic contraction
Mechanism: El Paso pathway: structural pension (60% funded) + commercial tax base erosion + deficit. Not cross-border dependent but creates regional bank exposure through muni bonds and local CRE.
Feedback Loops: Deficit → pension cuts → public employee exodus → service decline → business relocations → lower tax base → deeper deficit
Breakpoint: El Paso credit downgrade from AA OR pension requires POB issuance
Trigger: $55-62M deficit already, pension 60% funded, hiring freeze
Lag Time: 18-36 months from deficit to credit event

Name: McAllen Hidden Exposure → Shock Transmission
Pathway: External shock (peso crash, tariff, border closure) → Mexican shopper 28% revenue hit → Retail employment decline → Wage compression → Consumer stress → Municipal revenue decline → Credit pressure
Mechanism: McAllen still running old model (28% dependent) while others diversified. AA+ rating masks structural vulnerability. Wage decline (-5.5%) is early warning.
Feedback Loops: Shock → immediate retail hit → unemployment → consumer default → bank NCOs → further credit tightening
Breakpoint: McAllen loses AA+ rating OR unemployment >8%
Trigger: Not yet triggered — requires catalyst (peso, tariff, border event)
Lag Time: 3-6 months from shock to visible stress
